name: AIPM Student Membership
summary: Discounted student membership of the Australian Institute of Project Management, with mentoring, resources and free or discounted events.
who: Must be currently enrolled in study
how: Select Join now and provide evidence of enrolment such as a student card, course listing screenshot or enrolment confirmation.
catches: Student members can't vote at the AGM or in elections.
RegPM certification is limited to Individual Membership.

evidence.quote: To be eligible, you must be currently enrolled in study.
